property_summary: For every caller and value, only the contract owner can cause the contract to send funds out via sendMoney/withdraw (i.e., after any sendMoney call, the contract's balance can only decrease if the caller is the owner); the mutant that removes the onlyOwner check allows non-owners to withdraw/send funds, breaking this invariant for some inputs.
change_summary: Change onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove ownership check), so withdraw can be called by non-owners and thus change who receives funds.
